meta.name: experimental-design
meta.description: Design experiments and studies BEFORE data is collected — choosing a design, randomizing, blocking, and laying out treatment combinations so results are interpretable. Use whenever someone is planning a study, asks how to assign subjects/samples to groups, mentions randomization, blocking, stratification, controls, factorial or fractional-factorial designs, design of experiments (DOE), screening many factors, response-surface optimization, crossover or repeated-measures or split-plot designs, cluster/group randomization, Latin squares, plate layouts, batch/run-order effects, replication vs. pseudoreplication, or sequential/adaptive/group-sequential designs. Trigger even for informal phrasings like "how should I set up this experiment", "how do I avoid confounding", "what's the best way to test these 6 factors", or "assign these mice to conditions". For computing the sample size or power once the design is chosen, use statistical-power; for analyzing data already collected, use statistical-analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计实验方案，确保结果可解释
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在规划实验，需要选择合适的设计方法。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if planning a study and need to choose a proper design.

howto.what: 在收集数据之前帮你完成实验设计:根据你的目标选择设计类型(随机区组、析因、响应面等),用 Python 脚本生成随机化分配方案与实验运行表(固定随机种子,可重复),并提醒伪重复、混杂等设计错误。
howto.when: 当你在收集数据前询问如何设计实验、如何给样本分组,或提到随机化、区组、析因设计等术语时触发;非正式问法(如“6 个因素怎么测”)也会触发。

say.text: 我要比较两种药和安慰剂,60 只小鼠怎么随机分组?
say.note: 会生成随机分配表并检查各组人数。

say.text: 我想筛选 7 个因素,帮我生成一个 Plackett-Burman 设计。
say.note: 会生成随机化运行顺序的实验矩阵。

say.text: 怎么避免批次效应和伪重复?给我一个实验布局。
say.note: 会指出设计陷阱并给出布局建议。

howto.what_en: Designs experiments before data collection: chooses a design type (e.g., randomized block, factorial, response surface), generates seeded randomization schedules and DOE run sheets with scripts, and points out errors like pseudoreplication and confounding.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you plan a study before data collection: how to set up an experiment, assign samples to groups, or mention randomization, blocking, factorial designs, etc. Informal phrasings also trigger.

say_en.text: I'm comparing two drugs vs placebo. How do I randomize 60 mice?
I want to screen 7 factors. Generate a Plackett-Burman design.
How do I avoid batch effects and pseudoreplication? Give me a layout.
say_en.note: Flags design traps and suggests a layout.
